$comment: Expected-results baseline. CI compares a Playwright JSON run against this
and goes red only where reality diverges from the recorded findings.
test.fail() was removed from the suite by team decision on 13 August, so
Playwright's own exit code cannot carry 'this failure is known'. This file
carries it instead, which also means an UNEXPECTED PASS is detected and
named — the case test.fail() could never report.
expect:
pass     procedure must report passed, and must NOT carry a 'blocked'
annotation
blocked  procedure must report passed AND carry a 'blocked' annotation.
A blocked case executes in full and records the unmet condition
as evidence; the assumption, not the store, is why it cannot be
discharged
fail     procedure must report failed. The failure is the recorded
finding, so this is the green state
scope: which runs must contain this entry. The smoke set is the merge gate
and is checked in both directions, so a renamed or deleted spec fails
rather than quietly disappearing.
When a defect is fixed or an assumption goes stale, CI fails here first.
Update the Defect Log and this file together — never this file alone.

TP-01-003.note: Blog browsing. Read-only, and the only FN-01 procedure with no defect asserted against it: TP-01-001 carries DEF-F1-03/05, TP-01-002 carries DEF-F1-01/02, TP-01-004 carries DEF-F1-06.

TP-02-002.note: No colour option carries its own gallery image, so ENV-07 is not satisfiable. The spec asserts the block condition, so it turns red if the store gains per-variant images.

TP-03-004.note: Header and footer Search controls do not carry the field value. Four expect.soft failures; read-only.
